item.title: Stocks Fall as Nvidia’s Earnings Rally Sputters
item.description: Wall Street saw renewed volatility as Nvidia Corp.’s post-earnings rally fizzled out, a sign that investors are looking for more evidence about the durability of the artificial-intelligence trade. John Mowrey, CIO at NFJ Investment Group, brings us into the market open and talks about what Nvidia and Anthropic mean for the AI trade and value investing. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia Delivers a Beat and Raise in New Era After Jensen Huang
item.description: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern speak daily with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond. No other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day than "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Tech Stocks Decline as Worries Remain For Nvidia After Earnings
item.description: US technology stocks erased gains in the wake of Nvidia Corp.’s earnings, while traders looked to the mammoth market debut of Anthropic PBC as the next key test for the artificial intelligence trade.

item.title: Bitcoin Erases Bessent Rally as Leverage and Liquidity Fade
item.description: Bitcoin has erased all the gains from its late-summer rally as fading risk appetite and the record hack at exchange Binance drove investors to retreat, leaving the largest token trading in a thinner market increasingly vulnerable to sharp price swings.

item.title: Interest-Rates are 'Normal for Longer,' Not Higher, Says Ed Yardeni
item.description: Fed officials left rates steady last month after raising their benchmark rate in September for the first time in three years. Since the last meeting, officials have signaled broad agreement over additional hikes, but offered differing views on the appropriate pace. Ed Yardeni, Founder of Yardeni Research, discusses the markets and his interest-rate outlook. (Source: Bloomberg)
